methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series A → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.0x) to $60M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Transportation (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 3 same-sector peers exist in Transportation, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
REGENT Craft is a Series A stage transportation company that has raised $60M to date. The broader Transportation sector includes six tracked private peers (Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, FleetZero, Beyond Aero), though no public comps exist in the immediate comparable set. No same-stage or adjacent-stage peers with sufficient data density were available to support a median-based valuation approach.

The Stage-Progression method was the primary applicable triangulation technique. Using total capital raised ($60M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement yields an implied valuation of $120M. This reflects the expectation that REGENT will command materially higher valuation at the next funding round relative to its current raised capital base.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $102M to $138M, centered at $120M. This range reflects a ±15% sensitivity band around the stage-progression midpoint. Key uncertainties limiting analytical confidence are the absence of same-stage Transportation peers with disclosed metrics and the lack of public market anchors for the sector. Future updates to this analysis would benefit from additional private comparable data or expanded peer identification within Transportation infrastructure and vehicle development.
